title: Discord-Trivia-Bot Database Question Schema
description: Question data for a local file-based question database for Discord-Trivia-Bot.

difficulty.description: This question's difficulty. Should be "easy", "medium", or "hard".

correct_answer.description: Always a string. For true and false questions, the string should be exactly "True" or "False".

incorrect_answers.description: Array of incorrect answers. Should have three items, except for true/false questions.

answer_extension.description: Additional text that will display at the end of a round with this question.

answer_image.description: The URL of an image to display at the end of a round with this question.

question_image.description: The URL of an image to display with this question.
